run_extract_image_urls: run the script to extract image URLs from a web document dataset shard by job index
run_sync_dataset_from_s3: run the script to sync a filtered web document dataset from S3 to local disk
run_count_image_url_frequencies: run the script to count image URL frequencies using Counter and save as pickle
run_upload_pickle_to_s3: run the script to upload the image URL pickle file back to S3
run_cleanup_temp_files: run the script to delete temporary files after processing the dataset shard
